cases.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?
cases.answer:
Part 1
Historical view: documents in effect on 2026-09-14.

The superseded German AX-17 guidance (Document ID: DE-AX17-LBL-038, in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15) specified a historical starting dose of 50 mg OD for normal renal category [E1], 50 mg OD for mild renal category [E1], 50 mg OD for moderate renal category [E1] and 50 mg once daily [E2], and not recommended for severe renal category [E1].

Sources
[E1] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.6, Historical renal dosing
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=6
[E2] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.1–3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=1

Current version: DE-AX17-LBL-042 (DE AX17 Current Label v4.2), in effect since 2026-09-15. Ask for the current guidance to see it.

Part 2
Temporary hepatic monitoring enhancement requires baseline hepatic laboratory values with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1]. For ALT/AST >3x ULN, the action is medical review, for Bilirubin >2x ULN, the action is urgent review, and for mild isolated changes below the trigger, the action is to repeat the test [E2]. For renal dose modification, normal renal function (eGFR >=90) has a starting dose of 50 mg OD, a maximum of 100 mg/day, and routine monitoring [E4]. Mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89) has a starting dose of 50 mg OD, a maximum of 100 mg/day, and routine monitoring [E4]. Moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59) has a starting dose of 25 mg OD, a maximum of 50 mg/day, and monitoring recheck 2-4 weeks [E4], with an approved German renal starting dose of 25 mg once daily [E1, E3]. Severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29) has a starting dose of specialist review, a maximum of 25 mg/day, and enhanced monitoring [E4].

Sources
[E1] SB-AX17-2026-09 · SB AX17 2026 09 Safety Bulletin v1.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-10-07 · section: HelixNova Safety Bulletin SB-AX17-2026-09
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/SB_AX17_2026_09_Safety_Bulletin.docx
[E2] SB-AX17-2026-09 · SB AX17 2026 09 Safety Bulletin v1.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-10-07 · section: HelixNova Safety Bulletin SB-AX17-2026-09 › 4. Safety Evidence and Operational Guidance, Signal / Threshold / Action / Authority
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/SB_AX17_2026_09_Safety_Bulletin.docx
[E3] DE-AX17-LBL-042 · DE AX17 Current Label v4.2 · APPROVED · effective 2026-09-15 · p.1
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Current_Label_v4.2.pdf#page=1
[E4] DE-AX17-LBL-042 · DE AX17 Current Label v4.2 · APPROVED · effective 2026-09-15 · p.6, Table 3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Current_Label_v4.2.pdf#page=6

Earlier version: DE-AX17-LBL-038 (DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8), superseded on 2026-09-15. Ask for the historical guidance to see it.

cases.question: What did the German label say before the September 2026 revision?
cases.answer:
Part 1
Historical view: documents in effect on 2026-09-14.

The superseded German label (DE-AX17-LBL-038, in effect from 03-Feb-2025 to 15-Sep-2026) stated the historical starting dose for normal renal function was 50 mg OD, for mild renal impairment was 50 mg OD, for moderate renal impairment was 50 mg OD, and for severe renal impairment it was not recommended [E1, E2].

Sources
[E1] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.1–3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=1
[E2] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.6, Historical renal dosing
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=6

Current version: DE-AX17-LBL-042 (DE AX17 Current Label v4.2), in effect since 2026-09-15. Ask for the current guidance to see it.
